knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Medication administration is outside the support worker's role. The request is declined, recorded and passed to the provider the same day.
The indicator as worded requires routine environmental cleaning in settings other than participants' homes. Option 0 misstates it and option 2 is not what the standard says.
A used needle is not handled by hand. It is reported and disposal is arranged safely through the provider.

practicalCriteria: Given three supplied requests and a support plan, the learner classifies each as within the plan, declined, or referred, and records the decision for each.
In a role-play, the learner announces themselves, asks before entering rooms, and does not read or move personal papers or belongings.
Given two supplied hazards in a home, the learner pauses the affected work, does not handle the hazard, and notifies the provider.
passRule: Practical competence requires facility or provider observed assessment against the criteria above. A pass on the knowledge checks is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Signed classification sheet for three requests against a support plan
Observation note of the role-play for privacy and consent
Record of the hazard pause and the provider notification
stopWorkCriteria: Learner performs a task outside the support plan, including medication or clinical tasks
Learner handles a needle, sharps or medical waste by hand
Learner starts a general clean in an area with an unassessed suspected hazard
